channel.title: Hashif Habeeb
channel.description: The personal blog of Hashif Habeeb — developer and creator of DoosraBox, Interviewable, SayWhen and Lesson21. Essays and build logs on shipping software.

item.title: Why I finally started writing
item.description: A short note on starting a blog after years of meaning to — and what I plan to put here.

item.title: The long way to the keyboard
item.description: Born in India, raised in Jeddah, taught by a second-hand book on computers — the winding path from a UKG classroom to shipping software for a living.

item.title: Everything the résumé leaves out
item.description: The other story — happy beginnings, years of quiet fear, walks to tuition, a loss that broke a year, and the long work of finding my way back.

item.title: Four products, one lesson: shipping beats perfect
item.description: What building DoosraBox, Interviewable, SayWhen and Lesson21 taught me about the gap between a great idea and a live URL.
